entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
I need to return the VeloBand Cadence Sensor. Just give me the return authorization.
Okay, I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your order number or the email address associated with your VeloFit account?
It's sam.jones@email.com. Just tell me if it's a yes or a no on the return. I don't have a lot of time.

I'm pulling up your account now, Sam... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, delivered on December 20th. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
It's just hard to use and really confusing. Honestly, I expected more from it. The user manual wasn't any help. Can I return it or not?
I understand your frustration. It can take a moment to get used to the interface. I can walk you through some of the settings if you'd like...
No, I'm past that. I just want to return it. I'm looking at your website right now. It's within the return period.

You are absolutely right. My apologies. Let me just confirm the policy here... yes. I see you received it 31 days ago, and our return policy is for 90 days. You are well within the window. I can process this return for you immediately.
Okay, thank you. That's all I needed. What's the next step?

I've just initiated the return in our system. You'll receive an email with a prepaid shipping label and instructions within the next 15 minutes. Just print the label, attach it to the original box, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, you'll see a full refund to your original payment method in 3-5 business days.
Perfect. Thanks for your help, Charlie.
You're very welcome, Sam. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
